title: Remembering Allah During Success
paragraphs: Setelah bisnis kecilnya akhirnya menguntungkan setelah bertahun-tahun berjuang, Nizar menyadari dirinya merasa bangga atas usahanya sendiri, kadang lupa mengaitkan kesuksesannya pada sesuatu di luar kerja kerasnya sendiri. Seorang teman dekat dengan lembut mengingatkannya selama percakapan bahwa usaha yang sama bisa dengan mudah menghasilkan hasil yang berbeda, dan rasa syukur kepada Allah seharusnya tidak memudar hanya karena keadaan berjalan baik.

Pengingat ini membuat Nizar berhenti sejenak dan merenung, dan ia mulai dengan sengaja menyisihkan sebagian dari keuntungan barunya untuk sedekah, memperlakukan kesuksesannya sebagai amanah, bukan sesuatu yang sepenuhnya diraih sendirian. Merenungkannya kemudian, Nizar menyadari bahwa mengingat Allah saat lapang, dalam beberapa hal, lebih sulit daripada mengingat-Nya saat kesulitan, justru karena kesuksesan jarang menuntut refleksi yang sama.
answerKey: After his small business finally became profitable following years of struggle, Nizar noticed himself feeling proud of his own effort, occasionally forgetting to attribute his success to anything beyond his own hard work. A close friend gently reminded him during a conversation that the same effort could have easily produced a different outcome, and that gratitude toward Allah should not fade simply because things had gone well. This reminder made Nizar pause and reflect, and he began deliberately setting aside a portion of his new profits for charity, treating his success as a trust rather than something entirely earned alone. Reflecting later, Nizar realized that remembering Allah during ease was, in some ways, more difficult than remembering Him during hardship, precisely because success rarely demanded the same reflection.
